description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/Synthetic.swift. They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the swift pack would export (for example getter calls, default-argument expressions and swift-all summary steps are omitted), written to exercise the swift cases; they are not a CodeQL recording: Swift extraction requires a macOS executor that the pipeline does not yet have. Locations follow the Swift extractor: a span ends at the start column of its last token. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored synthetic bqrs <query_id>'.

cases.unresolved_indirect_call: call_sites: notify -> handler(message), a closure parameter, line 71
cases.virtual_dispatch: call_sites: persist -> store.save(args[1]) through protocol Store, two virtual_resolved candidates (FileStore.save, MemoryStore.save), line 37
cases.remote_to_sql: path_flows: String(contentsOf:) (line 22) reaches sqlite3_exec argument 1 (line 32) through the return of fetchRemote and the call into buildQuery
cases.argv_to_path: path_flows: CommandLine.arguments (line 36) reaches FileManager.createFile argument 0 (line 10) through the virtual call store.save
cases.sanitized_path: sink_sites and path_sanitizers: resolvingSymlinksInPath (line 56) dominates FileManager.contents(atPath:) (line 57) and lies on the flow to it
cases.dominating_guard: guards: count < 64 (line 62) dominates allocate(capacity:) at line 63, true_branch
cases.non_dominating_guard: guards: count < 64 (line 62) does not control allocate(capacity:) at line 66
cases.unknown_range: ranges: allocate(capacity: count) at line 66 is integral Int with lower and upper unknown
